item.title: EV manufacturers say production is getting easier, cheaper and more predictable in ABB Robotics survey
item.description: Automotive manufacturers are showing more confidence in EV production as it shifts from a disruptive new process to a more established manufacturing discipline, according to ABB Robotics’ latest Automotive Manufacturing Outlook Survey. ABB says more than two-thirds of manufacturers expect EV production to increase in 2026 versus 2025. Just as notable, 51% of respondents said... Read more »

item.title: UK government funds 484 new electric buses in 10 English regions
item.description: The UK may not be in the first ranks of EV hotspots with Norway and The Netherlands, but Albion is moving ahead with electrification far faster than some other countries we could name. On the streets of London, electric buses, taxis and rideshare vehicles are common sights, as are curbside EV charging stations. The UK... Read more »

item.title: New silver plating busbar line adds 4,500 tons/year of UK capacity for EV systems
item.description: Karas Plating has brought a new £1.5-million automated busbar electroplating line online in the UK, adding what the company says is the country’s widest-capacity silver-plating operation for copper busbars—components used in EV battery packs, power electronics and charging stations. The new 2.4-meter-wide line can process up to 200 kg of product every 20 minutes and... Read more »

item.title: Geely becomes second Chinese automaker to unveil 1,500 kW EV chargers
item.description: Chinese EV maker BYD made big headlines a few days ago when it unveiled a new version of its Blade Battery and a Flash Charger to go with it. item.title: Uber and Rivian partner to deploy up to 50,000 autonomous robotaxis
item.description: Rivian and Uber have announced a partnership to deploy 10,000 fully autonomous R2 robotaxis in the first phase of R2 robotaxi deployment. Initial deployments are expected to begin in San Francisco and Miami in 2028. Uber will invest up to $1.25 billion in Rivian through 2031, subject to the achievement of certain milestones. The goal... Read more »

item.title: ActionPower’s PRO20 power supply scales to 6 MVA, NEO-PRO battery cycler supports 1200 V EV packs
item.description: ActionPower and its South Korean distributor RED Solutions used InterBattery 2026 to introduce two test-system products aimed at EV battery and power electronics development: the PRO20 regenerative AC programmable power supply and the NEO-PRO battery testing and cycling system. item.title: Renesas’ bidirectional 650 V GaN switch replaces back-to-back FETs with one 110 mΩ device
item.description: Renesas has introduced what it calls the industry’s first bidirectional 650 V-class GaN switch with integrated DC blocking, aimed at simplifying power-conversion topologies in applications such as solar microinverters, AI data centers and onboard EV chargers. item.title: AMPECO launches new operations agent for EV charging networks
item.description: EV charging management software provider AMPECO has launched a new operations agent called CoOperator, which offers automated root cause diagnostics, a conversational interface, and the ability to execute operational actions in plain language. item.title: Advancements in thermal adhesives: enhancing battery cell-to-pack and cell-to-ribbon performance for EVs
item.description: Sponsored by Parker. A key to the advancement of high energy-density, lithium-ion, battery packs is effective management of heat generated during charge and discharge cycles. Heat is often managed by connecting battery cells and/or modules to a cooling plate or pack via thermally conductive materials (gap fillers or adhesives). item.title: TI’s IsoShield isolated power modules deliver up to 3x higher power density, shrink designs by 70%
item.description: Texas Instruments has introduced two isolated power modules that use its new IsoShield packaging technology to raise power density in applications including EVs and data centers.
